mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_logs ( admin_id, action_type, target_table, target_id, log_level, is_successful, http_method, request_uri, before_value, after_value, description, ip_address, user_agent, created_at ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, #{actionType}, #{targetTable}, #{targetId}, #{logLevel}, #{isSuccessful}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{description}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT al.id, al.admin_id, u.name as admin_name, al.action_type, al.target_table, al.target_id, al.log_level, al.is_successful, al.http_method, al.request_uri, al.before_value, al.after_value, al.description, al.ip_address, al.user_agent, al.created_at FROM admin_logs al LEFT JOIN users u ON al.admin_id = u.id WHERE al.id = #{id}

SELECT al.id, al.admin_id, u.name as admin_name, al.action_type, al.target_table, al.target_id, al.log_level, al.is_successful, al.http_method, al.request_uri, al.before_value, al.after_value, al.description, al.ip_address, al.user_agent, al.created_at FROM admin_logs al LEFT JOIN users u ON al.admin_id = u.id WHERE al.admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY al.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM admin_logs WHERE created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
